violated_contract: A Review question on the explicit terminal allowlist must settle its proposal; all other pre-application conflicts must release. Releasing terminal premises re-offers unanswerable questions, while treating unknown or reversible exclusions as permanent silently loses valid questions.
canonical_prevention: Release pre-application conflicts by default. Settle only explicit permanent evidence exclusions (deleted, tombstoned, hidden, source purged, archived or user-rejected), collapsed entity identities, incompatible entity types and invalid item shapes. Settlement atomically resolves only the matching proposal evidence version and refunds attention. Already-true affirmative identity answers succeed without another merge. Reader-path lifecycle tests cover both terminal exclusions and default release.
